text.p: Blue chip Shell Pakistan Ltd 10-rupee stock jumped 7.0 rupees, or 2.90 percent, to 248 on Friday on fresh buying on hopes of hefty profits for the year ending in June, dealers said.
A turnover of 9,400 shares of the company were recorded at the Karachi Stock Exchange.
"Investors expect hefty profits from the company for the year ending in June," dealer Mohammad Iqbal said.
"The company in its half year results up to December 1996 had announced after-tax profits of 379 million rupees compared to previous year's net profit of 102 million."
Dealers said investors were unloading state-run Pakistan State Oil stocks to take positions in Shell Pakistan on hopes of higher returns. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
